content.text: Lots of people don't do any exercise nowadays. It's really bad! You get fat and sick. Kids are always on their phones and stuff. The government should do something.
At present, a large number of people do not exercise regularly.
lack of physical activity is harmful,
it can lead to obesity and various diseases.
, many children spend most of their free time on electronic devices.
, governments should take measures to promote active lifestyles.

→ Kids get loads of homework → Prices went down a bit → Phones are really bad for sleep → Lots of stuff is thrown away

Some people prefer trains. Other people prefer buses. Trains are faster, but buses are cheaper.

content.text: 5. Tarefa cronometrada: edite o parágrafo (15 min)
Reescreva em registro acadêmico, com coesão (meta: 80–100 palavras).

I think tourism is kind of good and bad. Lots of tourists come to my city every year and they spend loads of money, which is great for shops and stuff. But they also make the streets really crowded and dirty! You can't walk anywhere in summer. And prices go up a lot, so locals can't afford things. The government should do something about it, like making tourists pay a tax or whatever.
O aluno lê. O professor verifica: sem contrações? sem
Is tourism good for your city?

content.text: Many young people spend a great deal of time on their phones. · Prices increased significantly. · In my view, this is a harmful idea/This idea has several drawbacks.

Tourism has both advantages and disadvantages for my city. Every year, a large number of visitors spend considerable amounts of money, which benefits local businesses. However, tourists also make the streets crowded and dirty, particularly in summer. Moreover, this demand causes prices to rise, so many residents can no longer afford basic goods and services. To address these problems, the government could introduce a tourist tax and invest the revenue in public services.
